arxiv-2206-01303.title: Spaces of Bounded Measurable Functions Invariant Under a Group Action
arxiv-2206-01303.creator: Samuel A. Hokamp
arxiv-2206-01303.description:
A 2022 arXiv research paper by Samuel A. Hokamp. In this paper we characterize spaces of L ∞ L^{\infty} -functions on a compact Hausdorff space that are invariant under a transitive and continuous group action. This work generalizes the author’s 2021 results, found in [ 1 ] , concerning the specific case of unitarily and Möbius invariant spaces of L ∞ L^{\infty} -functions defined on the unit sphere in ℂ n \mathbb{C}^{n} . 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification
Primary 46E30.

arxiv-2412-02383.title: A multiplicity result for Hamiltonian systems with mixed periodic-type and Neumann-type boundary conditions
arxiv-2412-02383.creator: Wahid Ullah
arxiv-2412-02383.description: Abstract We investigate the multiplicity of solutions for a Hamiltonian system coupling two systems associated with mixed boundary conditions. Corresponding to the first system, we impose periodic boundary conditions and assume the twist assumption commonly used for the Poincaré–Birkhoff theorem, while for the second one, we consider a two-point boundary conditions of Neumann type.

pmc-10972694.title: CrossFit and “Cancel Culture”: Probing Practitioners’ Responses to the “Canceling” of Greg Glassman
pmc-10972694.creator: Dale Spencer, Derek Silva, Delphine DiTecco, Carmen West
pmc-10972694.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). In this article, we explore the responses of crossfit practitioners to the ‘canceling’ of Greg Glassman in the aftermath of racist tweets and comments made in response to the killing of George Floyd. We draw on 50 interviews with crossfit practitioners to understand how they interpret and respond to the ‘canceling’ of Greg Glassman and the disavowal of CrossFit by prominent CrossFit athletes and organizations.

pmc-11435118.title: Balancing the Oral–Gut–Brain Axis with Diet
pmc-11435118.creator: Rebecca Kerstens, Yong Zhi Ng, Sven Pettersson, Anusha Jayaraman
pmc-11435118.description: Background: The oral microbiota is the second largest microbial community in humans. It contributes considerably to microbial diversity and health effects, much like the gut microbiota. Despite physical and chemical barriers separating the oral cavity from the gastrointestinal tract, bidirectional microbial transmission occurs between the two regions, influencing overall host health.

pmc-11862266.title: Life narratives of individuals with psychosis in ethnic minority and migrant communities in Canada and the Netherlands
pmc-11862266.creator: I Jansen
pmc-11862266.description: Background Increased psychosis risk has long been reported for some migrant and ethnic minority populations, a finding has been replicated in different parts of the world, with risk seeming to persist for further generations. Several explanations such as genetic liability or selective migration, higher cannabis-use or higher exposure to neurodevelopmental risk factors were considered unlikely explanations.

Here, we report the synthesis of LIG by CO2 laser engraving of polyimide (PI) films, followed by doping with polyethylenimine (PEI). pmc-12463987.title: Immunomodulatory peptide–drug conjugate MEL-dKLA suppresses progression of prostate cancer by eliminating M2-like tumor-associated macrophages
pmc-12463987.creator: Ik-Hwan Han, Ilseob Choi, Soyoung Kim, Minjin Kwon, Hyojung Choi, Hyunsu Bae
pmc-12463987.description: Prostate cancer is one of the most common malignancies in men and is frequently associated with tumor-promoting inflammation. Tumor-associated macrophages (TAMs) are known to facilitate cancer progression by suppressing antitumor immunity. Therefore, targeting TAMs represents a promising strategy for cancer therapy.

pmc-12639348.title: Acute Adenosine Receptor Antagonism in Combination With Acute Intermittent Hypoxia to Promote Breathing Plasticity in Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis: Protocol for a Randomized, Double-Blinded, Placebo-Controlled Trial
pmc-12639348.creator: Priscila Sales de Campos, May Smith-Hublou, Wendy L Olsen, Wagner Souza Leite, James P Wymer, Nicholas J Napoli, Alicia K Vose, Michael T Pulley, Gordon S Mitchell, Barbara K Smith, Tiffany Leung, Amy Schwartz
pmc-12639348.description: BackgroundRespiratory impairment is a major concern in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), shortening survival and lowering quality of life. One therapy with promise to delay respiratory decline in ALS is acute intermittent hypoxia (AIH), consisting of alternating periods of breathing mildly hypoxic (9%-12% O2) and normoxic (21% O2) gas.

pmc-13000729.title: Aptamer-functionalized exosomes combined with doxorubicin suppress GBM progression and enhance chemoradiosensitivity by promoting pyroptosis
pmc-13000729.creator: Jing Wang, Li Peng, Xinxin Zhong, Siqi Zheng, Xiuhua Liang, Menghan Du, Xiangning Xia, Ting Guo, Lidan Zheng, Yingying Fang, Yinghong Tian, Yusheng Shi, Xingmei Zhang
pmc-13000729.description: Glioblastoma (GBM) is the highly lethal intracranial tumor characterized by low survival rates and high recurrence, partly attributable to the challenges posed by the blood-brain barrier (BBB). To enhance therapeutic efficacy, the Exo-U2-Dox complex was engineered by functionalizing mesenchymal stem cell (MSC)-derived exosomes with the GBM-targeting aptamer U2 and integrating them with doxorubicin (DOX).

pmc-13356842.title: MRI Monitored Mn-THPPmPEG12-Guided Phototherapy Elicits Abscopal Immunity and Synergizes with PD-1 Blockade in Triple-Negative Breast Cancer in Mice Model
pmc-13356842.creator: Le Bai, Mengjie Ma, Wenxia Yuan, Shaowei Bo, Zeyu Xiao, Dong Zhang, Xing Zhong, Junjie Zeng, Changzheng Shi, Liangping Luo
pmc-13356842.description: PurposeThe study was to develop a clinical-translational theranostic photosensitizer, Mn-THPPmPEG12, for multiparametric MRI-monitored photodynamic therapy (PDT) of triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC), and to evaluate its potential to elicit abscopal immunity and synergize with PD-1 blockade.MethodsMn-THPPmPEG12 was synthesized and characterized, and its MRI contrast capability was evaluated.

pmc-13474775.title: The association between anxiety levels and postoperative pain following endodontic treatment: a prospective observational study
pmc-13474775.creator: Hatice Sağlam, Hakan Arslan
pmc-13474775.description: BackgroundThe aim of this study is to investigate the association between preoperative anxiety and postoperative pain after endodontic treatment in vital symptomatic mandibular molar teeth.Methods132 patients who came for endodontic treatment of symptomatic molars were asked to complete the ‘Modified Dental Anxiety Scale’ (MDAS) to assess preoperative anxiety.

pmc-13567934.title: Force-Balance Model and Stable Operating-Point Regulation of a Prestretched Repulsive Electromagnetic Elastomer Artificial Muscle
pmc-13567934.creator: Junjie Wang, Shuang Cao, Ziyu Wang, Huifeng Zhang, Yiqing Wang
pmc-13567934.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Attractive electromagnetic actuators operated under open-loop control are susceptible to positive feedback instability because the attractive force increases as the separation decreases, making it difficult for the actuator to remain at an intermediate position. Here, we propose a prestretched repulsive electromagnetic–elastomer artificial muscle and establish a force-balance model based on the intersection between the electromagnetic repulsive-force curve and the elastomer restoring-force curve.
